authLink.expired: This confirmation link has expired. Send a new email from this page.

link.title: Get my lists back on another device
link.description: Optional. Linking an email and a password lets you sign back in from another device. Everything else works without it.
link.afterConfirm: Available once the email is confirmed.

email.label: Email address
email.pending: A confirmation email was sent to {email}. Open the link to confirm.
email.sent: A confirmation email was sent to {email}. Open the link to confirm.

password.label: Password
password.saved: Password saved. You can now sign in from another device.

signOut.label: Sign out
signOut.confirmAnonymous: Confirm — with no linked email, your lists will be lost

login.title: Get my lists back
login.description: Sign in with the email and password you set up on your other device.
login.noAccount: No account? You don’t need one: <link>just pick a nickname</link>.

stats.title: My stats
stats.empty: Nothing to count yet. After your first session, you’ll find your votes here, your favourite cuisine and the restaurant that wins most often.
stats.favoriteCuisineHint: {count, plural, one {# positive vote} other {# positive votes}}
stats.privacy: These numbers only count your own votes — never the other participants’.

groups.title: My groups
groups.description: Leaving a group means you’re no longer pre-invited to its sessions. The ones you’ve already joined stay as they are.

ai.title: AI assistants
ai.description: Plug Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor into your account: tell it where you ate, it files the restaurant in the right list; ask it to set up a session, it takes care of it.
ai.example: “I ate at La Ba, it was great.”

token.title: For clients without OAuth: personal token
token.summary: If your client doesn’t offer to sign in to onmangekoi.
token.scope: A personal token only covers the restaurant catalogue and your lists. Sessions, votes, history and your profile need the recommended connection.

created.warning: Copy it now: this token won’t be shown again. It gives access to your lists, keep it to yourself.
created.urlHint: For a client that only accepts an address: the token is in it, don’t share it.
created.jsonHint: Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code and most MCP clients.

foodConstraints.title: What I can’t eat
foodConstraints.description: Optional. A restaurant that doesn’t work for you gets flagged in your sessions, without ever saying who: “1 participant can’t eat there”. You keep your veto for choosing between two cravings.
foodConstraints.saved: Noted: your sessions will flag it.

analytics.title: Usage statistics
analytics.on: On. They measure the journey (creating, inviting, voting, ranking) without ever sending your nickname, your email or your codes.
analytics.off: Off. Nothing measuring is loaded: no script, no cookie, no identifier.

data.title: My data
data.description: Get a copy of everything the app knows about you, or delete your account. What’s kept, and for how long, is on the <link>privacy page</link>.
data.exportFailed: The export failed. Try again in a moment.
data.deleteNote: Deletion is immediate and permanent. A confirmation you have to type out spells out what disappears before anything happens.

delete.title: Delete my account?
delete.description: Your profile, nickname, email and lists will be erased for good. Votes already counted in a finished session stay in the ranking, but nothing will link them to you any more.
